label: Modal spine H2: a metric Grim Reaper with spaced stations, its reach and objection audit
summary:
Target: modal spine stage one, horn H2 of the initial-state rival, the next test named by attempt ac336333 (a metric version of the Grim Reaper patchwork argument). Spec: specs/modal-spine-metric-grim-reaper.toml. ENCODING. TruthCore.Causality.MetricGrimReaper adds a TimeClock (a real time coordinate strictly increasing along the order of moments, Mathlib StrictMono), metrically finite pasts (readings at or before t bounded below, Mathlib BddBelow) and spaced descents (every slot at least some fixed delta > 0). The local Reaper pieces and the gluing step are those of GrimReaperPatchwork, restricted to spaced descents below populated moments: two OPEN premises, spaced local pieces (37d4e072) and spaced patchwork (bb7b476c). One clock serves every world of the frame and time is linearly ordered (type-class assumption); a world-indexed clock is not built. RESULTS. populatedPastsMetricallyFiniteOfPatchwork (f5ede5eb): in every accessible history every populated moment has a metrically finite past (4365c3c5). In linear time a metrically infinite past has a spaced descent by a theorem (spacedDescentOfUnbounded); no separate countable-coinitiality premise appears, but a real clock exists only for orders embedding in the reals, so countable coinitiality is absorbed into the clock's existence, not eliminated (times with no real clock, such as reverse omega_1, the long line or lexicographic R x R, are outside the scope); the proof composes GrimReaperPatchwork.arrangementImpossible and hence IndexedSignalReaper.impossible, without restating them. Strength orders: coinitial pieces and patchwork strengthen the spaced ones (535d5cb8, 296c3904; a spaced descent is coinitial in linear time); control 2 shows the pieces order strict (silent registers) and the two premises jointly strict, while strictness of the patchwork order alone is not checked. Begun populated pasts strengthen metrically finite ones (3f6bddb7), strictly by control 2, so founded => begun => metrically finite. Controls (83fd4e6f): (1) in the beginningless integer history each spaced premise holds without the other and populated pasts are not metrically finite; (2) positive real times (open below, finite: the order and metric shape of FLRW cosmic time): for every register frame both spaced premises hold and the coinitial ones do not both hold, and with silent registers coinitial local pieces fail; populated pasts metrically finite and not begun; with A3 prime b (6dd276f0) holding, A3 prime w (6d71688e) fails; (3) non-negative real times, nothing present at 0: for every register frame both spaced premises hold and the unrestricted ones do not both hold; populated pasts begun, not founded; begun coming-to-be possible. REACH. The conclusion is that no populated past is metrically infinite, not that populated pasts are begun. CLOCK. Metric finiteness is not invariant under reparametrization (arctan makes integer pasts finite; ln t makes FLRW pasts infinite). Disambiguation 725f3417 (CLOCK) separates CLOCK_1, the physically privileged duration (cosmic or proper time; PrivilegedClock, an explicit primitive marker), from CLOCK_2, any order-preserving real coordinate (TimeClock). The theorems hold for every CLOCK_2; statements and verdicts are read with CLOCK_1. Why duration should matter: on the spatiotemporal route of the #367 audit (a possible isolated Placer, regions large enough for the mechanism, infinitary spatiotemporal patchwork, intrinsic powers), stations are duplicates of one patch, and a duplicate keeps its intrinsic (proper) duration; slots of at least delta supply a temporal spacing condition for duplicates lasting at most delta; sufficient host spacetime room, protected connections and admissible realization are separate obligations, as qualified in the follow-up below. OBJECTION AUDIT (Substantive Objection Standard; repaired after the independent semantic challenge). Undercutting objection to the warrant of spaced patchwork, kept conditional on L (solutions of accepted laws are metaphysically possible) or C: the duration-blind recombination rationale assessed at that earlier stage is blind to durations; the follow-up below records a duration-sensitive positive rationale and its application limits; spaced and accumulating descents carry the same pieces in order-isomorphic positions, so it warrants the coinitial and unrestricted instances equally, which exclude a populated FLRW past (control 2) and, given C, first-moment continua (control 3). Answered only by a duration-sensitive principle, recombination of duplicates of one possible patch, room permitting, which warrants spaced arrangements only; its countable generalization is presented as plausible, not derived (#367 audit), and its bridge to the typed premise is not built. Misner-type logarithmic time (lead from memory, not read: Misner 1969, Absolute Zero of Time): kept as an open objection to the clock choice; under ln t the FLRW objection returns; reply: proper time is what ideal clocks measure and what duplication preserves; unresolved whether station patches near the singularity can keep a fixed proper duration. FLRW: no target, read with CLOCK_1 (spaced descents exist only below metrically infinite pasts; control 2); it still applies to begun populated pasts and to any bridge from metric finiteness to begun pasts. Benardete parity: no target (no spaced descent in [0, t] or (0, t]; controls 2, 3); its transfer to metrically infinite pasts remains an unsupported suggestion (needs the diagnosis that gluing fails for every infinite descending arrangement; no independent reason recorded). Rebutting objection, kept conditional on L (labelled like the FLRW row, which rests on the same principle): accepted theories have populated solutions with a metrically infinite past (Einstein static universe in general relativity; eternal free motion in Newtonian mechanics); if every solution of accepted laws is a possible history the conclusion fails. Established: these are solutions. Not established: that being a solution suffices for metaphysical possibility, the same principle the FLRW row relies on. It names no failing piece or gluing step; since an infinite past is the Reaper's intended target, it sets law-consistency as a guide to possibility directly against recombination; its weight is that comparison, not resolved. Global-compatibility reply: unchanged fork (overlapAgreeingWitnessesImpossible holds for every descent; on the value-agreement reading the argument does not start; on the duplication reading no acyclic gluing failure along a non-accumulating descent is recorded). Unsatisfiable-pair diagnosis: no mechanism. One clock and linear time: encoding scope, no mechanism of failure identified. Plain verdict: read with CLOCK_1 the typed premises' scope excludes metrically finite pasts; the earlier duration-blind rationale (#367 audit, defeasible) supports the refuted instances equally (conditional undercutting objection retained for that rationale); the follow-up below supersedes the earlier exclusive-warrant assessment with a substantive duration-sensitive support option whose realization remains open; the clock choice faces the open Misner-type objection; one rebutting objection is kept conditional on L. CONNECTION. The A3 prime w derivation (possiblyBegunOfEarlierGrounds) needs begun populated pasts; control 2 shows metric finiteness with A3 prime b does not give A3 prime w. Plans, not built: (1) a named open bridge, every populated moment with a metrically finite past has a begun past, which is exactly what FLRW denies, so the FLRW cost is isolated in that bridge rather than removed (the composition would be a transcription step and is not registered); (2) a metric arrival replacing the empty-moment step (A2 with A3), blocked because an open-below finite populated past has no empty moment and no such arrival premise is formulated. Nothing is attributed to Koons or Pruss. No premise is established. See docs/causal-regress-and-grim-reapers.md, Concrete metric station assignment and application audit. No source refetch or new claim attribution. ONE arbitrary-index capacity assignment uses a fixed-d detector/emitter/relay, location-relative own-code output, protected holding channels and no extra relevant inputs. With empty input at c(n+2), station n+1 issues c(n+1) and station n forwards it: all four actual PieceAt interfaces, including admissibility j=n+1, hold for both pieces as symbolic boundary data, conditional on accessible concrete realization. Pair witnesses change manifestations, not capacities; they do not define one complete trace. Existing complete-trace obstruction is consumed unchanged. Admissibility needs actual input codes drawn from the upstream c-family; forwarding every present input cannot be secured by deleting alien codes. Exact duplication alone supplies neither that boundary condition nor location projection, normal conditions, host spacetime room, connected protected channels or accessibility from v within the same h and R. A fixed d fits only sufficiently-long slots, whereas SlotsAtLeast allows every positive lower bound: arbitrary-speed scaling is not warranted. A fixed-d reductio could select gaps greater than d in an unbounded past using the existing selection proof with k/d, without changing the intended proper-time interpretation; this adaptation is not a certified new theorem and does not prove the existing every-descent premises. Proposed provisional assessment: substantive positive local construction rationale and duration-sensitive support option, unresolved countable realization/application warrant. No independently established acyclic gluing failure in sufficiently long slots; unspecified gluing failure has no evidential weight. Compatibility-constrained realization accounts for boundary consistency but still owes an independently justified admissibility rule; principle-L infinite cosmologies supply a conditional competing modal permission, not station insertion or a refutation without L. No arbitrary-clock result, no metaphysical counterexample from finite controls, no inference of contingency from temporal change. Verified strength implications: original spaced pieces -> fixed-d pieces (26a972d6), original spaced patchwork -> fixed-d patchwork (9ee3a4d8), fixed-d pieces -> selected local descent (ce2779a9). No strictness claimed. durationDescentOfUnbounded reuses the existing unbounded-clock seed and readingsUnbounded to select moments with gaps greater than d, starting at the same t in the original clock. Metric finiteness 4365c3c5 follows from selected-local plus fixed-d patchwork (8ceddce9), or uniform fixed-d pieces plus fixed-d patchwork (778bda9f), reusing arrangementImpossible. The exact local coverage needed by this split proof is one qualifying descent per infinite populated past; an absolute weakest metaphysical antecedent is not claimed. Original strong route remains with strong_version_needed recording surplus scope. CONNECTED PORTS: guardedStep n is one total response algorithm: absent -> issue own n; present j>=n -> unchanged forwarding; present j<n -> no issuance and no output. guardedOutputAdmissible certifies its local output-range invariant. pieceOfGuardedPort certifies all four actual PieceAt interfaces from faithful upstream/output/issuance boundary equalities and input address j>=n+1; a preceding guarded port at n+1 supplies that input bound. Thus admissibility can be supplied conditionally by local output guards plus the dictionary rather than assumed global originating issuance. Companion Comparator/NanoDa checks on ce2779a9 include these port and selection theorems. None constructs actual concrete devices or a global possible world. Positive rationale: finite detection/comparison/emission/storage/relay composition, intrinsic-power preservation, and Koons PGR/signal/persistence commitments in the already-read pp.9 and 18-21. Outstanding calibration must supply own n and code projection c n; finite labels have unbounded size across n, and no uniform physical runtime d or footprint is certified. Protected holding through unequal gaps is additional infrastructure, not a duplicate of the finite-duration device. Same-history accessibility and actual h-presence, protected channels and countable simultaneous normal-condition realization remain OPEN. Source assertions and finite local construction do not deduce PInfSP. Complete-trace obstruction consumed unchanged; no new generic gluing objection or metaphysical counterexample. It witnesses formal satisfiability under a stipulated relation, not causal coherence. The model is NOT metaphysical evidence that all such stations or complete networks can coexist: bearer-to-bearer causes do not automatically guarantee signal-event transmission, an intrinsically calibrated d-runtime across unbounded addresses, or a physical host. The strongest positive case retains Koons's PGR/HIP/CPNPP and intrinsic-power rationale plus actual finite-prefix structural feasibility, conditionally on a separate genuine countable causal-recombination principle. No actual-world God conclusion, initial instant or per-se-regress elimination follows. SEMANTIC CHALLENGE REPAIR (PR #1854): StationOperationAt conjoins the bearer chain and the moment-indexed register protocol with no bearer-register binding, so Causes is not modelled transmission and the causal conjuncts are idle in both proofs (their only formal effect is to strengthen 7d1b132f and weaken 9cb8c0ee). Dependency audit, Lean companions of 7fe26ec1: 9cb8c0ee holds exactly when no qualifying descent has finite-prefix-compatible operations (countableStationRecombinationIff); 4365c3c5 implies 9cb8c0ee (countableStationRecombinationOfMetricallyFinite), so given 7d1b132f the countable premise is equivalent to the conclusion it supports; fixed-duration patchwork 313105b4 implies 9cb8c0ee (countableStationRecombinationOfDurationPatchwork), so the new route trades a stronger local premise for a weaker gluing premise (implication order only). Its warrant must come from the countable recombination principle it instantiates; the strongest positive rationale is Koons's PInfSP and CPNPP, with the exact differences (power graph versus actual edges, neighbourhood versus finite-prefix antecedent plus CPNPP's already-realized graph, no fixed d) in definition 4085bd2b. Curation pass 2, lane D (#2103, 2026-11-27). 83fd4e6f tests 37d4e072. Omit co-possible adjacent pieces along spaced descents. The integer pivot history is populated at accessible world 1 and has no lower time bound. With silent registers no station issues, so adjacent pieces fail and the patchwork conditional holds vacuously. 83fd4e6f tests bb7b476c. Omit patchwork along spaced descents. On the populated integer pivot history the pivot registers realize adjacent pieces in accessible worlds, each with its own issue station. No one world glues the whole spaced descent, and the populated past has no lower bound. 83fd4e6f tests a8c2ef8c. In firstMoment, the sole bearer is present and contingent at accessible true at every positive time. Both spaced premises hold for each register frame because the nonnegative clock bounds each past and excludes an infinite descent with a fixed positive lower bound on slot lengths. 83fd4e6f tests fce4ac74. In firstMoment, zero is the first clock moment, so every populated past is begun. The sole bearer is present and contingent at accessible true at time 1. Repeated halving gives an infinite descent through positive moments below 1, so the populated past at 1 fails foundedness. 83fd4e6f tests 8072fc5a. In openBelow at true, the occupied positive real clock admits a coinitial descent by halving but no infinite descent with a fixed positive lower bound on slot length. With silent registers the coinitial local-pieces clause fails, while the weaker spaced clause holds. 83fd4e6f tests 0158110b. In openBelow, accessible true is populated by contingent concreta on the positive reals. The real-valued clock is bounded below by zero, while the earlier moments below any populated time have no first moment. This separates the stronger begun-past claim from metric finitude. The openBelow comparison falsifies the conjunction of the coinitial pieces and coinitial patchwork premises. For coinitial patchwork by itself this certificate leaves the omission untested.
blocker: 2026-11-22 proposed follow-up: finite compatibility of actual stations and the implication to fab16501 are now typed. Still open: independent positive warrant for a fixed positive proper-time runtime across unbounded station addresses, same-history protected boundary/code mapping, actual causal efficiencies and a non-circular countable recombination law that realizes all operations rather than merely duplicates their intrinsic powers. Finite prefix satisfiability does not logically yield a countable world, but that logical fact is not philosophical evidence against countable recombination. A bearer-register binding is needed before Ontic.Causes models signal transmission. Given 7d1b132f, 9cb8c0ee is equivalent to 4365c3c5, so it needs warrant from a general countable recombination principle (PInfSP/CPNPP plus a power-to-exercise bridge).
